name: safebyok-workspace
description: The safebyok workspace: the safebyok package, its companion packages under packages/, and the demos under demos/. Never published.
author: Philip (flip) Kromer <flip@mrflip.com>

scripts.lint: both() { pnpm lint:root; root=$?; pnpm -r --no-bail --stream --workspace-concurrency=4 lint "$@"; exit $(( root || $? )); }; both
scripts.typecheck: both() { pnpm typecheck:root; root=$?; pnpm -r --no-bail --stream --workspace-concurrency=4 typecheck "$@"; exit $(( root || $? )); }; both
scripts.test: both() { pnpm test:root; root=$?; pnpm build && SAFEBYOK_SKIP_BUILD_DEPS=1 pnpm -r --no-bail --stream --workspace-concurrency=4 test "$@"; exit $(( root || $? )); }; both
scripts.test:coverage: both() { pnpm test:coverage:root; root=$?; pnpm build && SAFEBYOK_SKIP_BUILD_DEPS=1 pnpm -r --no-bail --stream --workspace-concurrency=4 test:coverage "$@"; exit $(( root || $? )); }; both
scripts.justify:root: all() { pnpm lint:root; lint=$?; pnpm typecheck:root; typecheck=$?; pnpm test:root; exit $(( lint || typecheck || $? )); }; all
scripts.justify: all() { pnpm install || exit; pnpm lint; lint=$?; pnpm typecheck; typecheck=$?; pnpm test; tested=$?; pnpm size:check; exit $(( lint || typecheck || tested || $? )); }; all
scripts.size: SAFEBYOK_SKIP_BUILD_DEPS=1 pnpm --filter safebyok --filter safebyok-fastkey --filter safebyok-indexeddb --filter safebyok-react build && size-limit
scripts.demo:react: SAFEBYOK_SKIP_BUILD_DEPS=1 pnpm --filter 'safebyok-demo-react^...' build && pnpm --filter safebyok-demo-react dev
